review_notes: I read the whole file and checked the definitions in PoitouTransform.lean (poitouKernel, poitouTransformIntegrand, poitouTransform). The file is mostly pointwise derivative formulas with HasDerivAt lemmas and norm bounds. It also has Fourier-transform identities for the derivative profiles, and those already use Mathlib's Real.fourier_deriv. The definitions poitouKernelDerivative, poitouKernelSecondDerivative, poitouVerticalProfileDerivative and poitouVerticalProfileSecondDerivative are explicit closed forms for derivatives. They are not maps with preservation or inverse lemmas, and no bundled structure applies to them. poitouKernel f is linear in f, but this file has no separate linearity lemmas and nothing here would use a bundled linear map. Bundling it as a LinearMap would add abstraction without any practical gain. The remaining definitions (tartarAmplitudeSecondDerivative and regularizedScaledTartarSecondDerivative) are also explicit formulas. I found no justified finding under this rubric. The only uncertainty is that I did not search the other Odlyzko files for downstream uses.
